name: Noospheric Transference
community_notes: [APPROX] In the Command phase, selected units gain the Halo Override keyword (max selectable scales with battle size: 1/2/3 for Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught) and then one Override ability is chosen for them; only the chosen ability is modeled. Predation Protocols is expressed as a granted charge eligibility (rule is charge-after-Advance) and Muted Servomotors as the Stealth hit penalty. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Benedictions of the Omnissiah
community_notes: [APPROX] One Benediction is chosen at the start of the first battle round and stays active for CULT MECHANICUS units all battle; Panegyric Procession's +1 AP applies only within half range, a gate not encoded here. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Rad-Bombardment
community_notes: [APPROX] Only the BOMBARDMENT 'standing firm' branch is modeled (3+ → D3 mortal wounds to each enemy unit in the opponent's deployment zone at the start of the first battle round). The opponent's cover/stand-firm choice, the 'taking cover' branch (Battle-shock plus 5+ → D3 mortal wounds), and the FALLOUT effect across battle rounds 2–5 are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Cybernetic Augmentation
community_notes: [APPROX] Models can move through terrain features; the RUIN floor-level placement and base-overhang restrictions are not encoded. Full rule in raw-text store.
